header.subject: SEG 14 WB - CS 113 - PRIM ONLY LIFTED

body:
SEGMENT 17 FORCE MAJURE

SEGMENT 14 WESTBOUND – CS 113 – PRIMARY ONLY - LIFTED

 

Effective for gas day 
Monday,
February 9, 2026, Intraday 1 Cycle and continuing thereafter
, Natural has
operating capacity available for transports westbound on the Amarillo Mainline
System through Compressor Station 113 located in Will County, IL (Natural's
Market Delivery Zone).  Therefore, the Primary only restriction has been
lifted.  All transport services are available.

 

Please contact your Account
Director or Scheduling Representative if you have any questions.

.
